site_or_subject: SQM lithium brine extraction: SMA sanction and compliance program
operator: SQM Salar SpA (Codelco partnership agreed 31 May 2024)
record: Chile's Superintendencia del Medio Ambiente (SMA) opened sanction proceeding Rol F-041-2016 in November 2016 after an audit found brine over-extraction and incomplete information (six infractions; charge 1 covers brine extraction above the authorised amount between August 2013 and August 2015). The SMA approved SQM Salar's compliance program by Res. Ex. N° 38/2022 of 29 August 2022 (press-reported cost more than CLP 46,000 million, about USD 52 million). SQM filed progress report 15 of 20 on 27 Feb 2026 (program period 30 Aug 2022–28 May 2027). An environmental court had mandated an earlier plan in 2020.

record: Amazon's 10-K disclosures: servers' useful life 4 to 5 years from 1 Jan 2022 (depreciation -USD 3.6 bn), 5 to 6 years from 1 Jan 2024 (-USD 3.2 bn), then 'a subset of servers and networking equipment' cut from 6 to 5 years from 1 Jan 2025 citing 'the increased pace of technology development' in AI/ML (depreciation +USD 1.4 bn, net income -USD 1.0 bn, primarily AWS). Alphabet extended servers from 4 to 6 years beginning FY2023 (Q1-2023 depreciation -USD 988 m). Microsoft's 2025 Environmental Data Fact Sheet shows Deloitte & Touche LLP limited assurance on Section 1 (GHG, energy, water, waste and circularity tables) for FY24, with diverted waste of 28,285 t. Google reports 84% of data-center operational waste diverted (2024) and UL 2799 Zero-Waste validation at two data centers and one warehouse. No public filing stating a physical lifespan for GPUs, or an assured GPU resale/refurbishment volume, was found.

claim: Microsoft claims a 90.9% reuse-and-recycling rate for servers and components (FY24), six Circular Centers with three more under construction, 3.2 million components reused, and more than 2,500 t of packaging diverted from more than 30,000 server racks. Google claims about 8.8 million components harvested for reuse/resale in 2024, more than 7.5 million harvested and 2.6 million resold in 2025 (more than 54 million since 2015), and zero-waste campuses rising from 23% (2022) to 50% (2025).

gap: positive example with caveats: Microsoft's waste tables (including 28,285 t diverted) carry Deloitte limited assurance for FY24, but the 90.9% server reuse/recycling metric does not appear in the reviewed fact sheet; Google's component counts sit outside EY's FY2025 review scope (select GHG, energy and water metrics only) and UL 2799 covers site waste only; accounting lives of 5-6 years are estimates, and Amazon's 2025 reversal is the only filing-level signal that AI hardware is treated as shorter-lived.

Amazon's FY2024/FY2025 10-K and Q4-2024 8-K text as fetched did not reach the useful-life passages (tool truncation), and Alphabet's 4-to-6-year change was not fetched from a filing; depreciation figures remain via Hudson Labs and Converge Digest, so confidence left medium.
